"''We see it, Gold Leader. Ion torpedoes away!|Jon Vander and Wona Goban during the Battle of Scarif|audio=Vander-Goban-RO.flac|}} '''Wona Goban''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who flew with [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]] under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[Gold Leader]] [[Jon Vander]]. In [[1 BBY]], Goban was part of the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] that scrambled to support [[Rogue One|rebel forces]] trying to steal the [[Death Star plans|plans]] to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] on the [[planet]] [[Scarif]]. Flying a [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]] under the [[callsign]] [[Gold Nine]], Goban [[Battle of Scarif|engaged]] with the [[Imperial Navy|Imperial forces]] stationed above Scarif. Under orders from [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]], she led a group of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter|Y-wings]] in strafing the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Persecutor]]'' with [[ion torpedo]]s. This disabled the [[Star Destroyer|vessel]] and allowed it to be pushed into the [[Shield Gate]] that had been blocking transmissions from Scarif. ==Biography== ===Scramble for Scarif=== {{Quote|Red and Gold Squadrons, attack formations. Defend the fleet.|Raddus gives orders to Goban and the rest of Gold Squadron|audio=Raddus-RedAndGold-RO.flac|}} Wona Goban''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who served as a member of the [[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps|Starfighter Corps]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In [[1 BBY]],{{FilmDate|RO}} the Alliance learned that the [[Galactic Empire]] was constructing a [[superweapon]] known as the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] and that plans revealing a fatal flaw in the weapon's design were being stored on the [[planet]] [[Scarif]]. After a rogue [[Rogue One|squad]] of rebels set out on an unauthorised mission to steal the plans on Scarif, the Alliance scrambled its [[Rebel Alliance Navy|fleet]] to provide support. [[File:GoldSquadronShieldGate-RO.png|thumb|left|300px|Gold Squadron attacked the Shield Gate at Scarif, but had little effect.]] Goban was among the forces that arrived in the [[Scarif system]], flying as [[Gold Nine]] in one of the [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]]s of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]] under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[Gold Leader]] [[Jon Vander]]. [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]], who commanded the [[fleet]] from his [[flagship]], ''[[Profundity]]'', ordered Gold Squadron and [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]] to defend the fleet from the [[Imperial Navy|Imperial Naval]] forces above Scarif, while [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron]] was sent to the provide support on the surface. ===Strafing Star Destroyers=== {{Quote|That Star Destroyer's disabled.|Raddus reacts to Wona Goban's strafing run|audio=Raddus-Disabled-RO.flac|}} After part of Blue Squadron passed through, the Empire closed the [[Shield Gate]] above Scarif, blocking any further craft from reaching the surface. Gold Squadron and Red Squadron then conducted repeat attack runs on the [[Golan M3185 space station|gate's]] defense [[turret]]s and control linkages, but it quickly became clear they lacked the firepower to destroy it. Raddus then gave the command for the [[squadron]] to engage the [[Star Destroyer]]s attacking their fleet,''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' and Vander ordered his pilots to take advantage of an opening. [[File:PersecutorDisabled-RO.png|thumb|right|300px|Wona Goban lead a strafing run on the ''Persecutor''.]] Goban then led a group of four other [[BTL Y-wing starfighter|Y-wings]] in strafing the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Persecutor]]'' with [[ion torpedo]]s. The barrage penetrated the Destroyer's [[deflector shield]]s, which had been previously weakened by Blue Squadron pilot [[Barion Raner]], and caused a systems shut down that completely disabled the vehicle. With the ''Persecutor'' floating dead in [[Realspace|space]], Raddus ordered the [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvette]] ''[[Lightmaker]]'' to ram into the Destroyer, causing the ''Persecutor'' to collide with the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Intimidator]]'' and then the Shield Gate, destroying both. With the gate down, the rebels on the surface were able to transmit the [[Death Star]] plans up to the fleet and a portion of the rebel forces, including parts of Gold Squadron, then managed to successfully escape with the plans. ==Personality and traits== Goban had [[Color|tan]] skin and dark [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== While flying, Wona Goban wore an orange [[flight suit]] with two [[code cylinder]]s on the left sleeve, a white [[flak vest]], and a [[Diagnostech life support unit]]. Goban's [[K-22995 light flight helmet]] was white and gray with red-and-yellow highlighting, a checkered black-white pattern on each side, and a symbol emblazoned on the central ridge. She flew a BTL-A4 Y-wing assault [[starfighter]]/[[bomber]] during the Battle of Scarif. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|It was incredible to be in the cockpit. It was everything I had imagined a Rebel fighter cockpit would be like; as soon as I was there, I knew I was going into battle and firing ion torpedoes. Even though the shot was only of my head, the full costume was quite intricate. I didn't dare drink too much water as it takes quite a bit of fiddling to get in and out of…|Gabby Wong|{{WebCite|url=https://authory.com/JohnBishop/Rogue-Ones-Gold-Nine|text=Rogue One's Gold Nine⁠|date=2017-07-10|author=[https://authory.com/JohnBishop Bishop, John]|work={{WebCite|url=https://makingstarwars.net|text=MakingStarWars.net|work=[https://makingstarwars.net makingstarwars.new]|archivedate=20190331080625}}, [https://authory.com Authory] {{C|new host}}|archivedate=20200809025654}}}} Wona Goban was portrayed by actress [[Gabby Wong]] in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film, ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''. Wong was credited only as Gold Nine in the film, with the character then being identified as Wona Goban, a [[tuckerization]] of Wong's name, in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. [[File:Wona_Goban_helmet.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Wona Goban's flight helmet]] Wong received a call from her agent about the role and went in for a meeting with the casting director; she then read dialogue to a camera for scenes that were later sent to the [[Gareth Edwards|director]]. She was booked for a day of costume and helmet fitting and a two-day shoot alongside actor [[Richard Glover]], who portrayed [[Red Twelve (Rebel Alliance)|Red Twelve]] in the film. Despite the fact that they would be shooting only her head, Wong wore a full costume that was fairly intricate and difficult to take off, so she avoided drinking too much water while wearing it. Wong shot her scenes in an [[X-wing starfighter]] cockpit, but as it was decided that it should be Y-wings firing the ion torpedos, the footage of her was then rotoscoped into existing archive footage of a Y-wing cockpit.{{ILM|url=john-knoll-discusses-rogue-one|text=JOHN KNOLL DISCUSSES TECHNOLOGY AND INNOVATION ON ROGUE ONE: A STAR WARS STORY}} Wong recorded dialogue as well, but because of the final sequencing of the battle, the lines she had recorded did not quite fit, and she was asked to come back during post-production for [[Wikipedia:Dubbing (filmmaking)|ADR]]. In the end, however, her voice was not used, and the character ended up being dubbed by [[Vanessa Marshall]]. ==Appearances== *''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' {{1stID|Wona Goban}} *''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' *{{ILM|url=john-knoll-discusses-rogue-one|text=JOHN KNOLL DISCUSSES TECHNOLOGY AND INNOVATION ON ROGUE ONE: A STAR WARS STORY}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Birth of the Rebellion}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Pilots of the Rebel Alliance}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Wona Goban#kanon |es=Wona Goban |fr=Wona Goban |ja=ウォーナ・ゴバン |ko=워나 고반 |nl=Wona Goban |pl=Wona Goban }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Goban, Wona}} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Gold Squadron personnel]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]]
